question: Mr. Becks starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards the East. He then takes a right turn, drives 16 km, turns right and drives 28 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 21 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 19 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Mr. Becks starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards the East.

He then takes a right turn, drives 16 km, turns right and drives 28 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 21 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 19 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e86b4412960c9ebbff1dc3e3581b3d9fd0ba3de4223fd829a677da9e3d667c58.png] 

Thus, Becks has to drive 5km south to reach point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
